notes:
Prospect: mid-market analytics SaaS. Started with Hosted API eval (embeddings + search). Good fit for Redwood’s cost controls and model routing. Currently running a small Hosted POC (indexing ~250k docs). Key convo points:
- Wants Dedicated for predictable throughput & data isolation if POC scales. Focus: VPC peering + KMS integration.
- Security asks: need SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML integration guide, audit log formats, retention/archival policies, ability to set 90/180/365 day retention windows per environment.
- Network: prefer minimal egress, will require VPC peering and private link options; ops wants diagram and CIDR/IP ranges.
- Performance targets: chat latency <200ms median (US-East), embedding throughput target ~150 RPS for batch indexing, cost sensitive on token pricing for embeddings.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models for embeddings and rerank to control cost, but willing to use Redwood-verified curated models for chat if quality/regression checks pass.
- Rollouts: requires canary + automatic fallback to lower-cost variant when Dedicated pool saturated. Needs clear SLAs for failover.
- Compliance: must support SSO (Okta), audit logs forwarded to SIEM, KMS/HSM for key separation, and data residency in us-east region.
- Quote summary: AE provided three-tier Dedicated worksheet (base reserved + burst + Optimize recommendations). POC pricing flagged as "mid"; finance needs line-item ARR for Q2 planning.
- Customer language: "We like the cost transparency and the console traces — main hold up is SOC2 + VPC details so our security team can sign off."
- Next immediate deliverables: SOC2 report + SSO config guide + VPC peering diagram + Dedicated pricing worksheet.
- Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize recommendations to shrink token spend with caching/quantization once on Dedicated.
- Internal notes: push for infra scoping call week of 2026-03-17, loop in solutions engineering and infra architect.
